meta.title: Change a question's field type in Table View

plan.title: Change Question Field Type in Table View

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create flow for an RFP event.
Configure the event with a Technical/RFP stage.
Work on the RFP stage where the questionnaire is configured.
Apply an available RFP template containing questions.

args.goal: On the RFP questionnaire in Table View, locate a question with a Vendor Response, open the Edit control next to its field type, verify the available types are exactly Short Text, Long Text, Single Select, Radio, Number, Attachment, and Date, choose a different field type, and stop with the question visibly showing the newly applied type.

steps.note: Perform and verify the field-type edit interaction that no dedicated catalog step exposes.
Confirm the field-type change completed without an application error.
